d: We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.
q: 6+ years building and running production software, including 3+ years on backend systems at scale.
A track record of owning work end to end, from an ambiguous problem to a solution running in production.
Experience working directly with customers, partners or business stakeholders and turning their needs into technical plans.
Strong C# and .NET (.NET 8+), ASP.NET Core APIs and microservices design; Clean Architecture, CQRS/MediatR and DDD fundamentals.
Hands-on Kafka in production: partitioning, consumer groups, delivery semantics, idempotency, retries and DLQs, and the outbox pattern.
Redis in production: cache-aside, TTL and invalidation, distributed locks and rate limiting, with awareness of consistency trade-offs.
Solid relational modelling and SQL (PostgreSQL or SQL Server), with Dapper or EF Core and query performance tuning.
Production front-end experience with a modern framework (Vue/Nuxt, React or Angular) and TypeScript.
Integration experience: REST and webhook design, OAuth2/OIDC, API versioning, and third-party systems such as ERP, payments or delivery platforms.
Comfort with Docker, Kubernetes basics, CI/CD and observability tools such as Datadog.

A product mindset: you start from the customer's outcome, push back when a request is not the real problem, and measure whether what you shipped is used. Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to present to an engineering team and a restaurant group's executives on the same day.
Experience in restaurant tech, retail, POS, payments, loyalty or delivery aggregator integrations.
A previous role as a Forward Deployed, Solutions, Integration or Customer Engineer at a product company.
Building with LLMs and AI agents in production (prompting, tool use, evaluations), applied to customer workflows.
Mobile exposure (Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin, Flutter or React Native), or experience with super-app and mini-app models.
Product analytics and instrumentation (Mixpanel, Snowflake, SQL-based analysis). Arabic, and experience working with customers in Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
r: We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to sit between our customers and our product. You will embed with strategic merchants and partners, ship production code that solves their problems, and turn what you learn into reusable platform capabilities.

Large chains and integration partners often need more than configuration: custom integrations, data flows and workflows that stretch the product. You own that work end to end, from the first discovery call to production rollout. This is a full-stack, customer facing engineering role. You write real code in our .NET microservices, Kafka-based event backbone and front-end apps, and you are measured on customer outcomes, not tickets closed.
Work directly with enterprise merchants, franchise groups and integration partners to understand their operations, systems and pain points.
Run technical discovery: map their workflows, data and existing systems (ERP, delivery aggregators, loyalty, payment providers) against Foodics capabilities.
Scope solutions, set clear expectations, and own delivery dates with the customer. Build and ship production software
Design and build backend services and integrations in .NET (C#) following Clean Architecture and CQRS.
Build event-driven flows on Kafka: producers, consumers, retries, dead-letter handling, idempotency and schema evolution.
Use Redis for caching, rate limiting and short-lived state, with sound invalidation and TTL strategies.
Build or extend front-end experiences (web apps, admin tools, mini-apps) when the solution needs a UI.
Ship through CI/CD and own what you ship: observability in Datadog, alerts, runbooks and on-call for your deployments.
Spot patterns across customers and propose platform features instead of one-off forks.
Write clear specs and handover docs so core teams can adopt and maintain what you built.
Be the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, backed by data on usage, impact and effort.
Turn one-off deployments into repeatable playbooks, tooling, SDKs and reference integrations.
Help define how FDE engagements are scoped and measured, and share learnings across Product, Engineering, Solutions and Customer Success.
x: We believe you will love working at Foodics!
We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

d: Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
As we continue to grow across the public and enterprise sectors, we are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to lead and manage government and strategic accounts.

This role goes beyond traditional SaaS customer success—you will act as a trusted advisor and account lead, owning end-to-end delivery, managing complex stakeholder environments, and translating media monitoring insights into actionable value for clients.
q: 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services , preferably within:
Proven experience working with government or public sector clients , managing complex stakeholder structures
Strong background in project delivery , with the ability to manage timelines, reporting, and client expectations end-to-end
Experience translating data and insights into clear, actionable recommendations for clients
Commercially minded, with experience identifying and driving account growth opportunities
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences
Tech-savvy and comfortable working with CRM and customer success tools (e.g., HubSpot, ChurnZero)
Highly proactive, organized, and client-centric in approach
What the hiring process looks like
Final stage (case study presentation interview / client scenario focused on delivery & insights)
r: Own and manage a portfolio of government and enterprise accounts , acting as the primary point of contact across all stakeholders
Lead end-to-end account delivery , ensuring projects, reporting cycles, and commitments are executed on time and to a high standard
Translate media monitoring and social listening insights into strategic recommendations that drive client outcomes
Drive customer adoption, engagement, and retention through proactive account planning and value realization
Build strong, trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders, including within government entities
Identify opportunities for account growth , including upsell and cross-sell of additional Lucidya solutions
Collaborate closely with Product, Support, and Professional Services teams to deliver seamless customer experiences
Act as the voice of the customer , feeding structured insights back into the business
Monitor and report on key success metrics (e.g., adoption, NPS, campaign performance, sentiment trends)
Who will succeed in this role
Someone who thinks like an account owner, not just a platform enabler - comfortable navigating government environments, leading delivery, and turning insights into real client impact.
